question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 4:
solution:
The correct answer is '**trapped**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context of the passage is about children being stuck in a cycle of poverty due to their working conditions in hazardous industries.
 
• The appropriate word should describe the state of being unable to escape from the situation.
 
• "**Trapped**" (फँसा हुआ)&
